logical_classes.utility: Deterministic commands, search, inventory, and stateless lookup. No reasoning or planning required.
logical_classes.economy: Mechanical edits, narrow checks, retrieval, and routine research. Bounded, low-risk, and highly repetitive.
logical_classes.standard: Ordinary implementation, planning, integration review, and normal feature work. Default for productive work.
logical_classes.expert: Architecture, shared contracts, security/migration/concurrency, adversarial review, unresolved risk, and repeated failure recovery.

routing_inputs.uncertainty: How well the outcome is known in advance. Low = deterministic, high = exploratory.
routing_inputs.dependency_breadth: Number and coupling of affected interfaces or modules.
routing_inputs.shared_contract_changes: Whether the work modifies contracts other slices depend on.
routing_inputs.blast_radius: Impact scope if the change fails. Low = isolated, high = cascading.
routing_inputs.reversibility: Whether the change can be cleanly rolled back.
routing_inputs.security_and_data_risk: Exposure of credentials, PII, access control, or data integrity.
routing_inputs.cross_layer_state: Whether the change touches multiple architectural layers (UI, API, DB).
routing_inputs.architecture_ambiguity: How much architectural discovery is needed before implementation.
routing_inputs.proof_difficulty: How hard it is to produce fresh evidence for the acceptance claims.
routing_inputs.repeated_failure: Number of prior failed attempts on the same or adjacent work.
routing_inputs.user_model_override: Explicit model selection by the user, preserved regardless of policy.

role_defaults.vision_dependent_parity_review: requires vision capability, independent of intelligence class

triggers: architecture ambiguity unresolved after initial investigation
blast radius rated high or critical
user model override requesting higher class
escalation_policy.behavior: Escalate one class level per trigger, up to expert. Record the specific trigger as escalation reason. Multiple triggers may escalate directly to expert.
escalation_policy.unverified_behavior: When no mapped class is available or observation fails, status is UNVERIFIED. Config-file intent without runtime observation does not constitute verification.

evidence_contract.requested: The class, effort, and any user override requested by the agent or owner.
evidence_contract.resolved: The class, provider, model family, and effort selected by the host or adapter.
evidence_contract.observed: Fresh independently attested model, effort, and provider as reported by the runtime.
evidence_contract.fail_honest: Requested and resolved values are not observed evidence. Missing attestation is unknown and cannot support PASS. No model is verified merely because its config file contains the intended ID.

adapter_defaults.expert_escalation: Use high effort only when material risk requires it.

adapter_defaults.effort_evidence: Per-role and spawn-time effort overrides are supported. Record requested, resolved, and observed effort separately; missing attestation leaves only observed effort unknown.
